Hear It From Bharat Sir Himself

A short introduction to Wellington Spoken English, straight from the founder.

Your Trainer

Bharat B. Khandekar

Bharat B. Khandekar

Founder & Trainer, Wellington Spoken English & Personality Development Academy

Bharat Sir is an experienced English Communication, Spoken English and Personality Development trainer based in Maharashtra, with a background in Business Administration (MBA, LSBM College, London — affiliated with the University of Wales, Newport) and English Literature (M.A.). He started his coaching academy in Nagpur and later expanded his training work to Chandrapur.

Over the years he has worked as a Founder & Administrator, English Communication Trainer, Spoken English Trainer, Personality Development Trainer, Counsellor, Public Speaking & Soft Skills Trainer, and Career Guidance Mentor — building an approach centred on practical communication, confidence building, and real-world English usage rather than grammar alone.

MBA — London M.A. English Literature Founder, Wellington Academy Career & Placement Mentor

Teaching Philosophy

Confidence before grammar

Bharat Sir's professional focus is to help learners become confident communicators — not simply memorise English grammar. Every course at Wellington is built to move a student along this path, one stage at a time.

How We Train

The Wellington practice sheet

01 Group Discussions Weekly structured GDs on current topics — build on others' points, hold your ground, and speak with clarity in a group.
02 Debates & Public Speaking Argue real questions and speak in front of an audience — sharpening how you structure and deliver a point under pressure.
03 Interview Preparation & Role Plays Mock interviews, workplace conversations, and campus placement scenarios — rehearsed until they feel natural.
04 Personality Development & Soft Skills Voice, body language, etiquette and listening — the habits that shape how you're perceived, not just how you speak.
05 Career Counselling & Guidance One-on-one mentoring to connect communication skills to real academic and career decisions.
